Package com.im.njams.sdk

Class NjamsFeatures

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.im.njams.sdk.NjamsFeatures
  • public class NjamsFeatures
extends Object
    Owns the optional-feature list and the container-mode flag of an Njams client. The feature list is announced to the nJAMS server in the project message at start. Obtain via njams.features().

      • list

        public List<Njams.Feature> list()
        Returns the features of this client.
        Returns:
        copy of the current feature list

      • add

        public void add​(Njams.Feature feature)
        Adds a feature to the feature list. Features are announced to the nJAMS server in the project message when the client starts.
        Parameters:
        feature - to add
        Throws:
        NjamsSdkRuntimeException - if the client has already been started — a later change would never reach the server

      • remove

        public void remove​(Njams.Feature feature)
        Removes a feature from the feature list. Inherent SDK features cannot be removed.
        Parameters:
        feature - to remove
        Throws:
        NjamsSdkRuntimeException - if the feature is inherent, or if the client has already been started — a later change would never reach the server

        public boolean has​(Njams.Feature feature)

        Returns:
